description: READ accepts any category string as a filter, including the out-of-vocabulary legacy "general" — reads are never validated.

expired (TTL elapsed) → expired+deleted; permanent → untouched; old non-permanent → stale (reported, not deleted); fresh → neither.
Ratify commits via validated remember; invalid stays pending; reject discards.
